prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Desktop Pet Quick Controls Tutorial: Redesign the home_intro screen into a split layout showcasing interactive desktop shortcut highlights for calling, hiding, and speaking to the pet. (why: Multiple support emails complain about confusion over controlling, hiding, or interacting with the pet after completing onboarding.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Desktop Display Pre-Check Screen: Insert a pre-check screen before pet selection to test display scaling and desktop rendering compatibility. (why: Support emails report pets failing to appear on desktop or custom pet generation breaking on certain display setups.)
2: [home, new_flow] Pet Playbook Mini-Game While Waiting: Introduce an interactive pet training mini-flow on the waiting screen while the 3D pet model is generated. (why: The waiting step has a long median duration of 201s (mean 2336s), causing users to drop off while waiting.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Recovery & Sync Notice: Add clear copy explaining that signing in anchors pet progress to prevent data resets across logins. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing in again with a different account method.)
4: [home, wait_info] Step-by-Step Generation Status Tracker: Show granular progress indicators and estimated time remaining during pet rendering on the waiting screen. (why: The high waiting duration (mean 2336s) leads to drop-offs when users do not know how far along rendering is.)
5: [adoption, layout] Split-Screen Pet Selection Layout: Switch the pick_friend screen layout to split-screen to showcase full pet previews alongside choice options. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 60.9% with a high median time of 89s, indicating slow decision-making.)
6: [finish, notification] Desktop Notification & Quick Summon Setup: Prompt users on the finish screen to enable desktop tray notifications and hotkeys for fast pet access. (why: Users routinely submit tickets after onboarding explaining they do not know how to interact with or reveal their pet.)
7: [adoption, hint] Photo Upload Quality Guidelines & Validator: Add photo selection guidelines and explicit tips to ensure uploaded images produce high-quality pets. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted pet visual outputs.)
